🚀 RXLauncher v2.3  • Latest

**RXLauncher — High Performance Minecraft Java Launcher for Android**

A completely refined and stable experience for running Minecraft Java Edition on Android — now with further performance tuning, stability fixes, and improved modloader flows for Fabric/Forge/NeoForge.

[Version: v2.3] • [Status: Stable] • [Platform: Android]

---

## ✨ What’s New in v2.3

RXLauncher v2.3 focuses on reliability, performance polishing, and better mod/runtime handling across devices. Key improvements make the launcher smoother on low-end devices and more resilient when installing runtimes or mods.

### 🎨 UI & Design Improvements
- Minor UI polish across settings and profile screens
- Improved download/progress indicators for asset & runtime downloads
- Clearer mod conflict warnings and better visual grouping

### ⚡ Performance Improvements
- Reduced memory footprint during startup
- Faster JRE initialization on ARM devices
- Smoother animations and reduced UI jank

### 🔧 Stability & Reliability
- Fixed crashes during certain mod installations and world loads
- Improved error reporting for missing natives or runtimes
- More robust handling for interrupted downloads and partial installs

### 🧩 Modloader & Runtime Enhancements
- Better Fabric / Forge / NeoForge auto-detection and install flow
- Faster mod scanning and loading time for large modpacks
- Conflict detection improvements and safer profile switching
